Athletics.name: Athletics
Athletics.description: Covers: lifting, pushing, carrying, jumping, throwing heavy objects and forcing doors through bodily strength. Not: scaling walls, which is Climbing. Primary attribute: Power.

Climbing.name: Climbing
Climbing.description: Covers: scaling walls, cliffs, rubble and structures by grip and strength, with or without rope. Not: free-running across obstacles at speed, which is Parkour. Primary attribute: Power.

Swimming.name: Swimming
Swimming.description: Covers: moving and staying afloat in water, diving, holding breath and surface rescue swims. Not: rescue work on land, which is Search and Rescue. Primary attribute: Endurance.

Running.name: Running
Running.description: Covers: sprints, chases and distance running on foot. Not: vaulting obstacles mid-run, which is Parkour; moving by Quirk, which is Quirk Mobility. Primary attribute: Speed.

Parkour.name: Parkour
Parkour.description: Covers: free-running over rooftops, walls, railings and urban obstacles at speed, including safe landings. Not: slow vertical ascents, which is Climbing. Primary attribute: Speed.

Acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
Acrobatics.description: Covers: balance, tumbling, flips, rolling out of falls and twisting in midair. Not: evading an incoming attack, which is Dodging. Primary attribute: Speed.

Stealth.name: Stealth
Stealth.description: Covers: moving unseen and unheard, hiding, and slipping past people in the moment. Not: watching a target over time, which is Surveillance; locks and alarms, which is Infiltration. Primary attribute: Speed.

Conditioning.name: Conditioning
Conditioning.description: Covers: sustained exertion, enduring heat, cold, pain and hunger, staying conscious through injury and recovering breath. Not: resisting fear or mind control, which is Willpower. Primary attribute: Endurance.

Striking.name: Striking
Striking.description: Covers: unarmed blows: punches, kicks, elbows, knees and headbutts with footwork and guard. Not: holds and throws, which is Grappling; blows driven by a Quirk, which is Quirk Output. Primary attribute: Power.

Grappling.name: Grappling
Grappling.description: Covers: holds, throws, takedowns, joint locks, pins and escaping them. Not: binding a subdued person with tape or cuffs, which is Capture. Primary attribute: Technique.

Melee Weapons.name: Melee Weapons
Melee Weapons.description: Covers: fighting with hand weapons: batons, staves, knives, blades, chains and improvised clubs. Not: thrown or fired weapons, which is Marksmanship. Primary attribute: Technique.

Marksmanship.name: Marksmanship
Marksmanship.description: Covers: aiming and firing guns, launchers and support-gear projectiles, and throwing weapons accurately. Not: aiming a Quirk, which is Quirk Output or Quirk Control. Primary attribute: Technique.

Capture.name: Capture
Capture.description: Covers: restraining a subdued or cornered person safely with capture tape, cuffs, zip ties, binding cloth or nets, and keeping them restrained. Not: winning the fight first, which is Grappling or Striking. Primary attribute: Technique.

Dodging.name: Dodging
Dodging.description: Covers: evading attacks, projectiles and falling debris the character can see coming. Not: absorbing a hit on a guard or shield, which is Blocking. Primary attribute: Speed.

Blocking.name: Blocking
Blocking.description: Covers: taking a hit on a guard, arms, shield or hardened body and staying on one's feet. Not: getting out of the way, which is Dodging. Primary attribute: Endurance.

Combat Tactics.name: Combat Tactics
Combat Tactics.description: Covers: reading a fight, spotting openings and weaknesses, positioning, terrain use and planning an engagement. Not: directing teammates, which is Team Coordination or Leadership. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

Team Coordination.name: Team Coordination
Team Coordination.description: Covers: fighting and working beside others: combination moves, covering a partner, formations, relaying signals and timing Quirks together. Not: giving orders to a group, which is Leadership. Primary attribute: Cooperativeness.

Quirk Control.name: Quirk Control
Quirk Control.description: Covers: precise, safe and partial use of the character's own Quirk: fine targeting, holding back, shaping, utility and nonlethal use. Easy: a practiced everyday use. Hard: precise use in chaos or near civilians. Exceptional: a fine feat at the edge of the Quirk's scale. Not: raw force or damage, which is Quirk Output. Primary attribute: Technique.

Quirk Output.name: Quirk Output
Quirk Output.description: Covers: the force, damage, area and range of the character's own Quirk when used to attack or to move something heavy. Easy: a standard attack. Hard: overpowering a strong opponent or obstacle. Exceptional: a blow at the very top of the Quirk's scale. Not: precision and restraint, which is Quirk Control. Primary attribute: Power.

Quirk Stamina.name: Quirk Stamina
Quirk Stamina.description: Covers: keeping a Quirk active for a long time, using it again and again, pushing through its drawback and holding on at high Quirk Strain. Easy: a long practice session. Hard: a full fight at high Strain. Exceptional: staying functional past the Drawback's limit. Not: general bodily endurance, which is Conditioning. Primary attribute: Endurance.

Quirk Mobility.name: Quirk Mobility
Quirk Mobility.description: Covers: moving by means of the character's own Quirk: flight, propulsion, leaps, swinging, gliding, sliding and burrowing, including landings and carrying a passenger. Easy: a practiced route. Hard: a pursuit through a city or a passenger in danger. Exceptional: a maneuver at the Quirk's limit. Not: moving on foot, which is Running or Parkour. Primary attribute: Speed.

Quirk Analysis.name: Quirk Analysis
Quirk Analysis.description: Covers: working out how a Quirk works from what is seen, spotting its limits and counters, and using sensing or detection Quirks well. Easy: identifying a common Quirk type. Hard: reading an unfamiliar Quirk mid-fight. Exceptional: predicting a Quirk's hidden condition. Not: knowledge of famous heroes, which is Hero Industry. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

First Aid.name: First Aid
First Aid.description: Covers: emergency care in the field: bleeding control, splinting, burns, CPR, the recovery position, shock and moving the injured safely. Not: diagnosis and hospital treatment, which is Medicine. Primary attribute: Technique.

Search and Rescue.name: Search and Rescue
Search and Rescue.description: Covers: finding and extracting trapped or injured people: clearing rubble, shoring structures, rope, water and fire rescue, and carrying the injured. Not: moving crowds out of danger, which is Evacuation. Primary attribute: Power.

Evacuation.name: Evacuation
Evacuation.description: Covers: getting crowds and bystanders out of danger: calming them, directing exits, keeping order and reassuring victims. Not: extracting one trapped person, which is Search and Rescue. Primary attribute: Cooperativeness.

Perception.name: Perception
Perception.description: Covers: noticing things with the senses: details, ambushes, hidden people, sounds and changes in a room. Not: drawing conclusions from evidence, which is Investigation. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

Investigation.name: Investigation
Investigation.description: Covers: examining scenes and evidence, interviewing witnesses, following leads and working out what happened. Not: watching a target over time, which is Surveillance. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

Surveillance.name: Surveillance
Surveillance.description: Covers: watching people and places over time, stakeouts, tailing through a city, observation with cameras and spotting someone watching back. Not: moving unseen in the moment, which is Stealth. Primary attribute: Technique.

Persuasion.name: Persuasion
Persuasion.description: Covers: convincing people honestly: appeals, reasoning, encouragement and talking someone down. Not: lying, which is Deception; bargaining terms, which is Negotiation. Primary attribute: Cooperativeness.

Insight.name: Insight
Insight.description: Covers: reading people: emotions, intentions, lies, discomfort and what someone needs. Not: clinical assessment, which is Psychology. Primary attribute: Cooperativeness.

Deception.name: Deception
Deception.description: Covers: lying, bluffing, misdirection, keeping a cover story and holding a false identity in conversation. Not: physical disguise, which is Disguise. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

Intimidation.name: Intimidation
Intimidation.description: Covers: frightening, pressuring or cowing people through presence, threats and displays of strength. Not: honest persuasion, which is Persuasion. Primary attribute: Power.

Leadership.name: Leadership
Leadership.description: Covers: directing a group, giving orders in a crisis, keeping morale and taking responsibility, from class representative to agency team lead. Not: fighting in sync with a partner, which is Team Coordination. Primary attribute: Cooperativeness.

Media Presence.name: Media Presence
Media Presence.description: Covers: being in public view: interviews, press conferences, fans, hero image, social media and public speaking. Not: producing footage, which is Media Production. Primary attribute: Cooperativeness.

Etiquette.name: Etiquette
Etiquette.description: Covers: manners and protocol: formal Japanese speech and honorifics, business and agency meetings, ceremonies, and behaving well among the wealthy and powerful. Not: winning an argument, which is Persuasion. Primary attribute: Cooperativeness.

Negotiation.name: Negotiation
Negotiation.description: Covers: bargaining terms: contracts, sidekick and agency deals, prices, broker fees, ransoms and hostage talks. Not: lying, which is Deception. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

Streetwise.name: Streetwise
Streetwise.description: Covers: the street and the underworld: finding brokers and black markets, reading gang territory, hearing rumors and knowing who to avoid. Not: the law, which is Hero Law. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

Hospitality.name: Hospitality
Hospitality.description: Covers: service work: waiting tables, retail, convenience stores, cafes, customer handling and running an event. Not: cooking the food, which is Cooking. Primary attribute: Cooperativeness.

Teaching.name: Teaching
Teaching.description: Covers: instructing, coaching and mentoring: lessons, drills, feedback, exams and helping a student improve. Not: looking after young children, which is Childcare. Primary attribute: Cooperativeness.

Childcare.name: Childcare
Childcare.description: Covers: looking after children: comfort, play, safety, routines and earning a frightened child's trust. Not: medical treatment, which is First Aid or Medicine. Primary attribute: Cooperativeness.

Hero Law.name: Hero Law
Hero Law.description: Covers: Quirk and hero law: licensing, permitted Quirk use, self-defense, jurisdiction, arrest powers, use of force, liability and police procedure. Not: the business of agencies, which is Hero Industry. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

Hero Industry.name: Hero Industry
Hero Industry.description: Covers: the hero world: rankings, agencies, famous heroes and their public Quirks, sidekick contracts, merchandise and hero history. Not: legal rules, which is Hero Law. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

Medicine.name: Medicine
Medicine.description: Covers: diagnosis, treatment, pharmacology, surgical support and recovery care in a clinic or hospital. Not: emergency field care, which is First Aid. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

Science.name: Science
Science.description: Covers: physics, chemistry, biology and Quirk science, including Quirk genetics and lab research. Not: building devices, which is Support Engineering. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

Academics.name: Academics
Academics.description: Covers: academy coursework: mathematics, literature, history, modern Japanese, study habits and written exams. Not: foreign languages, which is Languages. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

Business.name: Business
Business.description: Covers: running an agency or company: budgets, marketing, accounting, management and brand strategy. Not: bargaining a single deal, which is Negotiation. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

Navigation.name: Navigation
Navigation.description: Covers: finding the way: city layouts, trains and transfers, maps, shortcuts and orienting in unfamiliar places. Not: living in the wild, which is Survival. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

Psychology.name: Psychology
Psychology.description: Covers: counseling, trauma care, profiling and understanding behavior, from a guidance office to a villain profile. Not: reading someone in the moment, which is Insight. Primary attribute: Cooperativeness.

Languages.name: Languages
Languages.description: Covers: foreign languages, English classes, translation and talking with visitors from overseas. Not: Japanese coursework, which is Academics. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

Willpower.name: Willpower
Willpower.description: Covers: resisting fear, panic, intimidation, interrogation and mind-affecting Quirks, and holding to a decision under pressure. Not: physical endurance, which is Conditioning. Primary attribute: Endurance.

Support Engineering.name: Support Engineering
Support Engineering.description: Covers: designing, building, tuning and repairing support gear and hero-costume systems, and diagnosing faulty equipment. Not: hands-on metalwork and assembly, which is Fabrication. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

Fabrication.name: Fabrication
Fabrication.description: Covers: hands-on making and repair: machining, welding, wiring, sewing heavy materials and assembling parts. Not: designing the system, which is Support Engineering. Primary attribute: Technique.

Computing.name: Computing
Computing.description: Covers: software, networks, data recovery, security systems and intrusion. Not: building physical gadgets, which is Support Engineering. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

Driving.name: Driving
Driving.description: Covers: driving cars, vans, motorcycles and trucks, including pursuit and evasive driving. Not: moving under one's own Quirk, which is Quirk Mobility. Primary attribute: Speed.

Costume Design.name: Costume Design
Costume Design.description: Covers: designing hero costumes and outfits: materials, function, Quirk compatibility, image and the support-company request process. Not: building powered gear, which is Support Engineering. Primary attribute: Technique.

Media Production.name: Media Production
Media Production.description: Covers: filming, photography, editing, broadcasting and producing content. Not: appearing on camera, which is Media Presence. Primary attribute: Technique.

Demolition.name: Demolition
Demolition.description: Covers: explosives, breaching charges, controlled collapses, finding a structure's weak points and bomb disposal. Not: explosions made by a Quirk, which is Quirk Output. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

Infiltration.name: Infiltration
Infiltration.description: Covers: getting into places: locks, alarms, keycards, security routines and secured buildings. Not: moving unseen once inside, which is Stealth. Primary attribute: Technique.

Disguise.name: Disguise
Disguise.description: Covers: changing appearance: costumes, makeup, wigs, forged papers and holding a false look. Not: lying in conversation, which is Deception. Primary attribute: Technique.

Sleight of Hand.name: Sleight of Hand
Sleight of Hand.description: Covers: palming, pickpocketing, planting objects, card tricks and quick hidden hand work. Not: breaking into places, which is Infiltration. Primary attribute: Technique.

Performance.name: Performance
Performance.description: Covers: music, singing, dance, acting and stage shows. Not: hero interviews, which is Media Presence. Primary attribute: Technique.

Visual Arts.name: Visual Arts
Visual Arts.description: Covers: drawing, painting, graphic design and illustration. Not: designing hero costumes, which is Costume Design. Primary attribute: Technique.

Cooking.name: Cooking
Cooking.description: Covers: cooking and baking, from dorm meals to a restaurant kitchen. Not: serving customers, which is Hospitality. Primary attribute: Technique.

Writing.name: Writing
Writing.description: Covers: reports, essays, journalism, scripts, notes and persuasive writing. Not: coursework knowledge, which is Academics. Primary attribute: Intelligence.

Animal Handling.name: Animal Handling
Animal Handling.description: Covers: calming, handling, training and caring for animals, including police dogs and wildlife. Not: Quirks that command animals, which is Quirk Control. Primary attribute: Cooperativeness.

Survival.name: Survival
Survival.description: Covers: living in the wild: forests, mountains, camping, foraging, weather, shelter and finding water. Not: city routes, which is Navigation. Primary attribute: Endurance.
